translationResources.title: Radio
translationResources.description: Lets users pick exactly one option from a set. Use RadioGroup to manage the selection of several radios.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Apple is selected initially. Choosing Banana or Cherry replaces the current selection.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Pro is selected initially. Selecting another plan updates the result below.

horizontal.title: Horizontal layout
horizontal.description: Radios are stacked vertically by default; set direction="horizontal" to lay them out in a row.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large. A group size applies to all of its radios.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: color sets the semantic color of a radio: primary (default), success, warning or danger. A RadioGroup color applies to every radio of the group and overrides their own color.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Available stays selected when Sold out is pressed. The disabled group preserves Option A.

validation.title: Validation and helper text
validation.description: RadioGroup supports required, error and helperText. A standalone Radio can show errorMessage (with errorIcon) or helperText.

RadioProps.checked: Whether the radio is checked (controlled). Ignored inside a RadioGroup
RadioProps.defaultChecked: Initial checked state (uncontrolled). Ignored inside a RadioGroup
RadioProps.name: Native name attribute. Inside a RadioGroup the group's name is used
RadioProps.value: Value of the radio; identifies it within a RadioGroup
RadioProps.onChange: Called when the checked state changes (standalone radios only; inside a group use RadioGroup's onChange)
RadioProps.size: Radio size. Overridden by the RadioGroup size
RadioProps.label: Text label displayed next to the radio
RadioProps.aria-label: Accessible label, required when there is no visible label
RadioProps.color: Semantic color of the checked radio. Overridden by the RadioGroup color when the group sets one
RadioProps.error: Shows the error state (errorMessage replaces helperText)
RadioProps.errorIcon: Icon shown before the error message
RadioProps.errorMessage: Message shown below the radio when error is true (linked with aria-describedby)
RadioProps.helperText: Helper text shown below the radio (linked with aria-describedby)
RadioProps.ref: Ref to the native <input type="radio"> element
RadioProps.children: Label content (alternative to label; used when label is not set)
RadioProps.aria-labelledby: id(s) of the element(s) labelling the radio
RadioProps.aria-describedby: Extra ids of elements describing the radio (merged with the helper / error text)
RadioProps.style: Inline styles of the root wrapper

RadioGroupProps.name: Name shared by all radios of the group (a unique name is generated when omitted, so arrow-key navigation always works)
RadioGroupProps.label: Visible label of the group; also its accessible name
RadioGroupProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the group when there is no visible label
RadioGroupProps.onChange: Called with the newly selected value
RadioGroupProps.disabled: Disables every radio in the group
RadioGroupProps.size: Size applied to every radio in the group
RadioGroupProps.helperText: Helper text shown below the group (linked with aria-describedby)
RadioGroupProps.color: Semantic color applied to every radio in the group (overrides the radios' own color); when not set each radio uses its own color
RadioGroupProps.ref: Ref to the root wrapper element
RadioGroupProps.aria-labelledby: id(s) of the element(s) labelling the group (takes precedence over label)
RadioGroupProps.aria-describedby: Extra ids of elements describing the group (merged with the helper / error text)
RadioGroupProps.id: id of the element with role="radiogroup"
RadioGroupProps.style: Inline styles of the root wrapper

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A labelled group with a preselected value and a disabled option. The group is one Tab stop; arrow keys move and select. minerva-change reports the new value.

styles-states.title: Styles and states
styles-states.description: Horizontal direction, group sizes and colors, per-radio helper and error messages, and a disabled group.

form.title: In a form
form.description: The group is the form control: it submits the selected value under name, required blocks submission while nothing is selected, and reset restores the value attribute.

props.isDisabled: Whether the radio cannot be checked, by itself or through its group (read-only).

events.minerva-change: A standalone radio was checked by the user; detail: { checked: true, value }. Inside a group, the group fires it.

slots.default: Label content (alternative to the label attribute).

props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The user selected another radio (like native radios).
events.minerva-change: The user selected another radio; detail: { value }.

methods.focus: Focuses the checked radio, else the first enabled one.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
